calls.statement:
SELECT join_date, count(*) AS version_rows, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, count(DISTINCT member_key) AS keys, sum(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS current_rows, min(valid_from), max(valid_from), min(home_store_id), max(home_store_id)
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-08'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT
 (SELECT max(join_date) FROM dim_member) AS max_join,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member m WHERE m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-10-03')) AS all_versions_of_those,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-10-03') AS distinct_ids,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_member_updates WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-10-03') AS stg_rows,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_member_updates s WHERE s.join_date = DATE '2026-10-03' AND s.member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member)) AS stg_not_in_dim,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-10-03' AND member_id IS NULL) AS null_ids,
 (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) AS max_sale
